threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: When you still ask for a flat white and don’t know what a ‘Hackney’ is in the context of a pub crawl, it’s pretty obvious.
Last night on the 68, a bloke serenaded us with a ukulele, claiming he wrote the best breakup song. Best entertainment I've had on a night ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy in a full tuxedo, top hat and all, waiting for the bus at Hermannplatz. Just another Tuesday in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a spontaneous party breaking out in an abandoned lot, complete with DJs and makeshift bars. It’s part of the charm.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can tell you exactly which taco truck has the best salsas for your late-night cravings. It’s all about the late-night options.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 19 Polk, juggling apples while his phone blasted Tchaikovsky. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all plazas in Gràcia are for es boc! Most only know about Plaza del Sol, but try any side street for real local vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still trying to figure out the 15 different ways to order a 'café con leche' at the local bar.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newcomers by their shocked faces at the prices in the local butcher. It’s like they think they’re at a fancy restaurant.
Last night, saw a guy trying to negotiate with a pigeon for his burger on the 35. Pigeons definitely have better taste than some night bus riders.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting at Tempelhofer Feld, I watched a kid flying a kite with their dog chasing it—no stress, just pure Neukölln vibes. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find spontaneous raves in abandoned buildings, as locals break out their decks and dance under the remnants of the past.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by how they navigate the BART delays. They plan their days around it, while newbies just shrug and wait.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 at 7th and Market, and a guy serenaded the whole bus with Frank Sinatra. Everyone was stuck in traffic but smiling. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a pretty plaza, but it’s the side streets with their quirky shops and local bars that truly breathe life into this neighborhood.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still fumbling with the metro map, missing the direct lines while staring in confusion at the station names.
